title: 第五卷四十五双星第五卷四十四深渊来使
content_zh:
渊尘星深处，在吸积核那道暗紫色的幽光背后，有一个不存在于任何星图上的空间。它不是物质，不是能量，不是虚空，而是一种介于“存在”与“不存在”之间的灰色地带——黑洞的引力在这里扭曲了一切物理法则，时间和空间被揉成一团又扯开，像一块被反复擀了亿万年的面饼。就在这片灰色地带的正中央，一个丑陋的庞大身影正在疗伤。
它的名字，在渊尘星古老的祭祀文中被称为“森灵”。
森灵可以幻化成不同的形态。它的本体是一只苍蝇，周边是不断翻涌的暗紫色浓雾，浓雾中隐约可见无数只眼睛——是密密麻麻如蜂巢般排列的复眼，每一只眼睛都在同时看向不同的方向。它的嘴藏在浓雾最深处，没有嘴唇，只有一圈又一圈向内旋转的利齿，每一颗利齿都是从一个被吞噬的星球残骸中提炼出来的金属内核打磨而成的。它用这张嘴吞噬过十三颗小行星、九十七艘迷失在渊尘星域的飞船，以及不计其数的渊尘星本土异兽。但它从来没有满足过——一个正在形成的黑洞永远不可能满足，就像一团永远在燃烧却永远烧不到自己的火。
此刻，它正用浓雾凝成的一只巨爪捂着自己的右臂。那里有一道剑痕，从肩膀一直劈到手腕，裂口边缘燃烧着三种不同颜色的火焰——韩昌锈剑的暗金色剑意最盛，惜若仙剑的金色仙光居中，霓依灵蛇灵力的银白冷焰稍弱，三道力量拧成一股，像三把不同材质的刀刃同时嵌进伤口，让它无法用浓雾重新填补裂口。每填补一寸，剑意就重新撕开一寸，反反复复，疼得它全身的复眼都在剧烈收缩。
“大意了。”它的声音在灰色空间里回荡，低沉而沙哑，每一个音节都带着一股腐烂的甜腻气味，“三个人，就三个人——那个人的剑意里带着三百年的恨，那个女半仙的剑气是天庭正宗，那条蛇的灵力更怪——不是热也不是冷，是‘蜕’。她的灵力在不停地蜕皮，我的吸力咬上去，只咬到一层空壳。他们怎么找到的？怎么来得这么快？”
它想不通。它精心布了这个局——先是利用渊尘星主对天狗军团的控制力，让天狗在联邦边界巡航挑衅，引诱龙族出手。它算准了龙族脾气暴烈、骄傲不容挑衅，一定会派出嫡系战部。果然七色龙来了，把雷暴铺满了整条隔离带。它又让天狗军团以吞噬漩涡消磨雷暴边缘，双方在中立带形成胶着。这一步棋它布得极满意——胶着意味着消耗，消耗意味着龙族会不断前压，不断逼近渊尘星域。它只需要等。等龙族的七色龙跨过那道看不见的引力临界线，黑洞的吸积盘就会像一张巨口一样合拢，龙族的天赋灵力和雷系能量将一次性填满它的吸积核。到那时黑洞将不可逆转地成型，它将彻底摆脱这个半成品状态，成为真正的、完整的、拥有自我意识的星空黑洞。
然后它就可以离开这里，去吞噬更多更肥美的猎物。第一个目标是阿尔法努星——它弟弟森智在那里已经潜伏了很久很久，在那颗冰雪覆盖的星球地心深处等着与它里应外合。
计划本应天衣无缝，但联邦那边有个人看出了它的底牌。那个叫江流云的人——它翻遍了自己吞噬过的所有渊尘人的记忆，找到了这个名字。联邦的思想家，军师，一个连灵力修为都不算顶尖的凡人。但就是这个凡人，从渊尘舰队后撤的航迹弧线里推演出了黑洞引力井的存在，又在龙族被锁死在中立带时提前预判了它的意图。更糟的是对面还有两个剑神——韩昌和惜若——偏偏是剑神。剑意和剑气都不是灵力，是意志。黑洞可以吞噬一切物质和能量，但意志这东西不归引力管。还有那条灵蛇霓依，灵力像蜕皮一样一层一层地剥落，咬上去永远咬不到最里层。这三个人联手的全力一击，它再也不敢硬接第二次。
森灵晃了晃它那团不成形的头，把注意力收回到伤口上。它从浓雾深处摸出一块巴掌大的骨片，用数十只复眼郑重地端详着。骨片呈暗金色，没有一丝裂纹，上面刻着极古老的纹路，纹路的风格不属于任何已知的凡尘文明。骨片边缘有三道极细的划痕，那是它当年被流放到这片星域时留下的。划痕代表三次保命的机会，它已经用掉了其中两次，现在只剩最后一道。
护心甲——主上赐予它保命的法宝。它记得那年跪在神殿最深处，漆黑如墨的阴影从神座上垂下来裹住它的肩膀，一个分不清性别分不清年龄的声音说：“骨片给你，功法给你。练成了，你就是这片星域的主人。练不成，你就和其他废料一起被黑洞吃掉。”它练成了。它的自信有一半在这块骨片上，另一半在主上赐的那本功法上。
它把骨片贴在伤口上，暗金色的光芒从骨片边缘渗出来。功法运转时，它的意识穿过了黑洞的引力井，穿过了渊尘星地壳，穿过了星域间无数光年的虚无，碰触到了阿尔法努星地心深处另一个同样丑陋、同样贪婪的存在。它的弟弟——森智。森智寄生在那颗冰蓝星球的地心熔核中，已经侵蚀了整片地幔的灵脉。阿尔法努星人对此一无所知，他们忙着在冰川断崖上建宗门、用时间静止术救人、在极光下载歌载舞。沈轻烟的弟子每天在冰湖边练剑，郑明俊在治疗室里把隐忍功法发挥到极致，没有人知道他们的脚下正潜伏着一个黑洞。
森智回应了哥哥的触碰，从阿尔法努星地心传来一阵极低沉的震动，像心跳，又像笑声。森灵把功法运转到极致，加快吸收渊尘星地核残余的能量，等伤好了，就联合森智把联邦那帮人全部吞进吸积盘。尤其是那两个剑神——他们的剑意不是意志吗？那就联合弟弟的吸力把意志连同人一起吞掉，吞进肚子里慢慢消化。它就不信，意志能扛得住黑洞内部的压强。
渊尘星宫殿，韩昌和惜若并肩站在最高处，两把剑交叉横于地核正上方。韩昌忽然偏了偏头，望向地底更深处，低声说：“它在疗伤。我感觉到它的气息在恢复。”惜若淡淡开口：“那一剑我们三个全力出手，伤了它一条胳膊。下次再出手，砍它的头。”韩昌笑了一声，把锈剑重新握紧：“你说话越来越像我徒弟了。”惜若没有接这个茬，只是说：“清澜在隔离带陪阿木找天狗首领。那孩子比你当年沉得住气。”韩昌沉默了一瞬，望着远处隔离带上仍在安抚天狗残兵的阿木和四只低声呜咽的神兽。“我想喝酒，大瓶的酒。”
紫月联邦会议厅，霓依带着渊尘星主走出空间裂隙。星主半身是血，剑诀散了，脊梁还直着。他开口第一句话不是求救，不是谈判，而是问杨思纯：“龙族的雷云还压在边界上吗？”杨思纯坦然点头。他问的第二句话是：“黑洞森灵的吸积核离临界值还有多远？”江流云把一份数据推到他面前，那是林博士刚分析出的推测值。他盯着那个数字沉默片刻，抬头时眼底全是血丝：“它逼了我数十年，把我的人当成它的粮食，把我的星球当成它的蛋壳。我和它，只能活一个。你们救了我的命，我不能承诺什么，但我可以签一个协议——在它死之前，渊尘舰队归联邦调遣。战后渊尘星的未来，由渊尘人自己决定。但你们能拥有一个设施齐全的军事基地，能不能接受？”
杨思纯站起来，走到他面前伸出手：“紫月联邦不吞并任何文明。我们只交朋友，不要附庸。”渊尘星主握住他的手，转身对着江流云和凌霄然说了他最后知道的情报，也是他的投名状：“森灵有一个弟弟，叫森智，寄生在阿尔法努星地心深处。森智的存在只有我们几个知道。黑洞森灵一旦痊愈会加速吸积盘成型，跨过临界线完全体化。同时森智会在阿尔法努星响应，从内部引爆地核。内外夹击，把你们的盟友一个接一个拔掉。时间不多了。”
他淡淡笑了笑：“但是，只要有生命的东西，就一定有缺点。它那么喜欢吞，不知道算不算缺点。”
江流云点头：＂这不完全叫缺点，这算缺陷。而且是致命的缺陷。”他的眼睛扫过会议室的一角，清澜抱着东东坐在椅子仔细听着他们的对话，神情热烈而又专注，而那只可爱的小毛球正在打鼾，经过大量灵石的滋润，这小凶兽又进阶了一点，隐隐泄露的灵力冻的周遭的空间都有了一丝扭曲。
阿尔法努星，冰川断崖。沈轻烟站在治疗室中央维持着三个时间静止结界，灵力稳定如古井之水。窗外极光照亮了整片冰原，冰湖边的弟子们结束了一天的修炼正三三两两往回走。郑明俊在宗门后山的小屋里削着一根萝卜，萝卜是从风之眼星带来的种子在冰川边自己种的，很甜。铁木在通讯站值班，对着监测仪上平稳跳动的绿线打了个哈欠。没有人听到地心深处极深极暗的地方，传来了一声极低极沉的心跳——咚。森智在黑暗中翻了个身，开始啃噬最后一片未被侵蚀的地核。地核最后一层硬膜即将消失，滚滚岩浆即将爆发，森智期待的岩浆爆发将全面解开它的吞噬束缚，与大哥的双星闪耀马上就会实现。
主上规划的大一统星域即将到来。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
Deep in the Abyss Star, behind the dark purple light of the accretion core, there is a space that does not exist on any star map. It is not matter, energy, or void, but a gray area between "existence" and "non-existence" - the gravity of the black hole distorts all physical laws here, and time and space are kneaded and torn apart, like a piece of dough that has been rolled out repeatedly for hundreds of millions of years. Right in the middle of this gray area, a large, ugly figure was healing.
Its name is called "Forest Spirit" in the ancient sacrificial texts of Yuanchen Star.
Forest spirits can transform into different forms. Its body is a fly, surrounded by a dense dark purple fog that is constantly billowing. Countless eyes are vaguely visible in the thick fog - compound eyes densely arranged like a honeycomb, each eye looking in different directions at the same time. Its mouth is hidden in the deepest part of the thick fog. It has no lips, only circles of sharp teeth rotating inward. Each sharp tooth is polished from the metal core extracted from the remains of a devoured planet. It has used this mouth to swallow thirteen asteroids, ninety-seven spaceships lost in the Yuanchen Star Domain, and countless exotic beasts native to the Yuanchen Star. But it is never satisfied - a forming black hole can never be satisfied, like a fire that burns forever but never burns itself.
At this moment, it was covering its right arm with a giant claw made of dense fog. There was a sword mark there, from the shoulder to the wrist, with flames of three different colors burning on the edge of the crack - the dark golden sword intent of Han Chang's rusty sword was the strongest, the golden fairy light of Xiruo Fairy Sword was in the middle, and the silver-white cold flame of Niyi Spirit Snake's spiritual power was slightly weaker. The three forces twisted into one, like three blades of different materials embedded in the wound at the same time, making it impossible to refill the crack with thick fog. Every time it filled up an inch, the sword intent tore it open another inch, over and over again, so painful that the compound eyes all over its body were shrinking violently.
"I'm careless." Its voice echoed in the gray space, low and hoarse, with every syllable carrying a rotten sweet smell, "Three people, just three people - that person's sword intention carries three hundred years of hatred, that female half-immortal's The sword energy is authentic, and the snake's spiritual power is even weirder - it's not hot or cold, it's "sloughing off". My suction force only bites an empty shell. How did they find it so quickly?
It can't figure it out. It carefully laid out this plan - first, it used the control of the Yuanchen Star Lord over the Tengu Legion to let the Tengu patrol the federal border to provoke, luring the Dragon Clan to take action. It was sure that the Dragon Clan had a violent temper and was too proud to be provoked, so it would definitely send out its direct war corps. Sure enough, the seven-colored dragon came and covered the entire isolation belt with thunderstorms. It then allowed the Tengu Legion to consume the edge of the thunderstorm with its devouring vortex, and the two sides formed a stalemate in the neutral zone. He made this move extremely satisfactorily - stalemate meant consumption, and consumption meant that the Dragon Clan would continue to press forward and approach the Yuanchen Star Territory. It just has to wait. When the seven-color dragon of the Dragon Clan crosses the invisible gravitational critical line, the black hole's accretion disk will close like a giant mouth, and the Dragon Clan's innate spiritual power and thunder energy will fill its accretion core at once. By then, the black hole will be irreversibly formed, and it will completely break away from this half-finished state and become a true, complete, self-aware starry black hole.
Then it can leave here to devour more and fattier prey. The first target is the planet Alphanu - its younger brother Mori Chi has been lurking there for a long time, waiting to meet it from the inside out deep in the heart of the ice-covered planet.
The plan was supposed to be seamless, but someone on the Federation side saw its trump card. The person named Jiang Liuyun—it searched through the memories of all the Yuanchen people it had devoured and found this name. A federal thinker and military advisor who doesn’t even have the highest level of spiritual power.Pointed mortal. But it was this mortal who deduced the existence of the black hole gravity well from the retreating arc of the Yuanchen fleet, and predicted its intentions in advance when the dragon clan was locked in the neutral zone. What's worse is that there are two sword gods on the opposite side - Han Chang and Xiruo - who happen to be sword gods. Sword intention and sword energy are not spiritual power, but will. Black holes can swallow all matter and energy, but will is not a gravitational tube. There is also that spiritual snake Niyi, whose spiritual power peels off layer by layer like shedding skin, and if she bites it, she will never be able to bite the innermost layer. The three people combined their full strength to attack, and it never dared to take a second blow.
The forest spirit shook its shapeless head and returned its attention to the wound. It fished out a palm-sized bone fragment from the depths of the thick fog and looked at it solemnly with dozens of compound eyes. The bone fragments were dark gold in color, without any cracks, and were engraved with extremely ancient lines. The style of the lines did not belong to any known mortal civilization. There are three very fine scratches on the edge of the bone fragment, which were left when it was exiled to this star field. The scratches represented three chances to save life. It had used up two of them and now only had the last one left.
Heart Armor - a magic weapon given to it by the Lord to protect its life. It remembered kneeling in the deepest part of the temple that year, with a dark shadow hanging down from the throne and wrapping its shoulders. A voice whose gender and age could not be distinguished said: "I give you the bone fragments, and I give you the technique. If you master it, you will be the master of this star field. If you fail to master it, you will be eaten by the black hole together with other waste." It succeeded. Half of its confidence lies in this piece of bone, and the other half lies in the skill book given by the Lord.
It attached the bone fragment to the wound, and dark golden light seeped out from the edge of the bone fragment. When the technique was running, its consciousness passed through the gravitational well of the black hole, passed through the crust of the Yuanchen Star, passed through the void of countless light-years in the star field, and came into contact with another equally ugly and equally greedy existence deep in the heart of the Alfanu Star. Its younger brother - Mori Chi. Senzhi was parasitic in the molten core of the icy blue planet, and had eroded the spiritual veins of the entire mantle. The Alphanu people knew nothing about this. They were busy building sects on the glacier cliffs, using time-stopping techniques to save people, and singing and dancing in the aurora. Shen Qingyan's disciples practice swordplay by the ice lake every day, and Zheng Mingjun uses his forbearance skills to the extreme in the treatment room. No one knows that there is a black hole lurking under their feet.
Senzhi responded to his brother's touch, and a very low vibration came from the center of Alpha Nu, like a heartbeat and laughter. Sen Ling pushed his skills to the extreme, speeding up the absorption of the remaining energy in the Yuan Chen Star's core. After the injury healed, he teamed up with Sen Zhi to swallow all the people from the Federation into the accretion disk. Especially those two sword gods - isn't their sword intention will? Then combine the suction power of your younger brother to swallow the will together with the person, swallow it into your stomach and slowly digest it. It does not believe that the will can withstand the pressure inside the black hole.
In the Yuanchen Star Palace, Han Chang and Xiruo stood side by side at the highest point, with their two swords crossed directly above the earth's core. Han Chang suddenly tilted his head, looked deeper into the ground, and whispered: "It is healing. I feel its breath is recovering." Xiruo said lightly: "The three of us struck out with all our strength with that sword and injured one of its arms. Next time we strike, chop off its head." Han Chang laughed and held the rusty sword tightly again. : "You are talking more and more like my disciple." Xiruo did not pick up the challenge and just said: "Qinglan accompanied Amu in the isolation zone to find the Tengu leader. That kid is more calm than you were back then." Han Chang was silent for a moment, looking at Amu and the four whimpering mythical beasts who were still comforting the remaining Tengu soldiers in the isolation zone in the distance. "I want to drink, a big bottle of wine."
In the Ziyue Federation Conference Hall, Niyi led Yuan Chen Star Master out of the space rift. Star Lord's body was half covered in blood, his sword skills were scattered, but his spine was still straight. The first words he spoke were not to ask for help or to negotiate, but to ask Yang Sichun: "Is the Thunder Cloud of the Dragon Clan still alive?"Pressure on the border? Yang Sichun nodded calmly. The second question he asked was: "How far is the accretion core of the black hole forest from the critical value?" "Jiang Liuyun pushed a piece of data in front of him, which was the estimated value that Dr. Lin had just analyzed. He stared at the number in silence for a moment, and when he raised his head, his eyes were bloodshot: "It has forced me for decades, treating my people as its food and my planet as its eggshell. It and I can only live one life. You saved my life. I can't promise anything, but I can sign an agreement - before it dies, the Yuanchen fleet will be at the disposal of the Federation. The future of Yuanchen Star after the war will be decided by the Yuanchen people themselves. But is it acceptable for you to have a fully equipped military base? "
Yang Sichun stood up, walked to him and stretched out his hand: "The Ziyue Federation will not annex any civilization. We only make friends, not vassals. "Yuanchen Star Master held his hand, turned to Jiang Liuyun and Ling Xiaoran and told Jiang Liuyun and Ling Xiaoran the last information he knew, which was also his declaration of surrender: "Senling has a younger brother named Senzhi, who lives deep in the heart of Alpha Nu. Only a few of us know about Senzhi's existence. Once the black hole forest spirit recovers, it will accelerate the formation of the accretion disk and cross the critical line to fully integrate. At the same time, Senzhi will respond on Alpha Nu and detonate the earth's core from within. Attack from both inside and outside and pluck out your allies one by one. Time is running out. "
He smiled faintly: "However, as long as there is life, there must be shortcomings. It likes to swallow so much, I don’t know if this is a shortcoming. "
Jiang Liuyun nodded: "This is not exactly a shortcoming, it is a flaw. And it's a fatal flaw. "His eyes swept across the corner of the conference room. Qinglan was holding Dongdong on the chair and listening carefully to their conversation, with a warm and focused expression. The cute little fur ball was snoring. After being nourished by a large amount of spiritual stones, the little ferocious beast had advanced a little further. The space around the faintly leaked spiritual power jelly was slightly distorted.
Alphanu star, glacier cliff. Shen Qingyan stood in the center of the treatment room maintaining three time-stopping barriers, and her spiritual power was as stable as the water from an ancient well. The aurora outside the window illuminated the entire ice field, and the disciples by the ice lake were walking back in twos and threes after finishing their practice for the day. Zheng Mingjun was peeling a radish in the hut on the mountain behind Zongmen. The radish was grown by himself on the edge of the glacier with seeds brought from the Eye of the Wind star. It was very sweet. Tiemu was on duty at the communication station and yawned at the steadily beating green line on the monitor. No one heard a very low and deep heartbeat from the very deep and dark place in the heart of the earth - thump. Senzhi turned over in the darkness and began to gnaw at the last uneroded core of the earth. The last layer of dura mater in the earth's core is about to disappear, and the rolling magma is about to erupt. The magma eruption that Senzhi expects will fully release its devouring shackles, and the double star shining with his big brother will soon be realized.
The unified star field planned by the Lord is coming soon.
